off.title: Disable Scan Processing?
off.body: Turning this off will stop processing of any new photos you take and pause analysis using your skin profile. Your past results remain in your account unless you delete them. You can turn this back on anytime.

on.title: Enable Scan Processing?
on.body: By enabling, you allow Beauty Ally to process new images and use your skin profile to generate scan results.

delete.title: Delete Account & Data
delete.body:
⚠️ 
Deleting your account will permanently remove your profile, scan history, uploaded photos, OCR text, and results. This cannot be undone.

This deletes your Beauty Ally account only (not your Apple/Google account).

Active subscriptions must be canceled in the App Store or Google Play settings.
